content: Last time when I called emergency services (911) and Pandora wouldn't stop playing, just happened again. The only difference is that I had just gotten off the phone (while connected to Bluetooth in my car like last time). I'm wondering if it's​ another app that's buggy (BattOn, supposed to read battery status of Bluetooth devices like wireless headphones). Coincidentally, Pandora just released an update that has "bug fixes and updates to … in-car experience". I just updated it, and wonder if they fixed anything​ based on the e-mail I sent them about the problem.
